# Meddy Health

> Meddy Health is physician-guided primary care built around your nutrition, workouts, sleep, and labs. Now accepting our first 500 patients.

Meddy connects your everyday health data — nutrition, workouts, sleep, and labs — into one personalized plan your physician can actually act on. All medical services are provided by Sameer Aggarwal Medical PLLC and its licensed clinicians.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://getmeddyhealth.com/): Physician-guided primary care that connects nutrition, workouts, sleep, and labs into one plan.
- [Why Meddy](https://getmeddyhealth.com/why-meddy): Why primary care built around everyday life beats occasional appointments.
- [How It Works](https://getmeddyhealth.com/how-it-works): Track your health, surface what matters, get a physician-built plan, and watch progress build.
- [Longevity](https://getmeddyhealth.com/longevity): Stay healthier longer with preventive care that acts earlier.
- [Biomarkers](https://getmeddyhealth.com/biomarkers): Comprehensive lab testing and biomarker tracking over time.
- [Sleep](https://getmeddyhealth.com/sleep): See the quality of your sleep and understand your recovery.
- [Fitness](https://getmeddyhealth.com/fitness): See what your workouts are doing to your body.
- [Nutrition](https://getmeddyhealth.com/nutrition): See what your nutrition is doing to your body.
- [Weight Loss](https://getmeddyhealth.com/weight-loss): Understand what's actually moving your weight.
- [Medication](https://getmeddyhealth.com/medication): Know what your medications are actually doing.
- [Physician Care](https://getmeddyhealth.com/physician-care): Primary care that knows you beyond the office visit.
- [Pricing](https://getmeddyhealth.com/pricing): Three levels of physician-led support starting at $99/month.
- [Wearables](https://getmeddyhealth.com/wearables): Connect your Apple Watch, Oura, Fitbit, and more.
- [What We Test](https://getmeddyhealth.com/what-we-test): The labs a Meddy physician most commonly orders.
- [24/7 Care](https://getmeddyhealth.com/247-care): Primary care that doesn't clock out.
- [Book a Consultation](https://getmeddyhealth.com/book-consultation): Book a free 30-minute video visit.
- [Personalized Health Plans](https://getmeddyhealth.com/personalized-health-plans): A plan built around you.
